import { connect, NatsConnection } from "nats";

export async function pubHello(nc: NatsConnection) {
  nc.publish("hello.greeting", "hi");
}

export async function requestPing(nc: NatsConnection) {
  await nc.request("ping.echo", "data");
}

export async function subscribeHello(nc: NatsConnection) {
  const sub = nc.subscribe("hello.greeting");
  for await (const m of sub) {}
}
